questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some lights are fans.

Some fans are beds.

**Conclusions: **

(I) Some lights are beds.

(II) All beds are fans.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e91bf108ef94536abd71ec97dfaae82f3b57b8122a32322b0d6d9c9d3979985c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some lights are beds → False ( As, there is no direct relation between lights and beds. so, it can be possible but not definite)

(II) All beds are fans → False ( As, some fans are beds. so, it can be possible but not definite)

Thus, **Neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

14 ÷ 7 − 27 × 9 + 12 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a2f9ab33e780cba5010b6de702b28619de1d1b1c922808fce2123379d05d37.png] 

Given equation:

14 ÷ 7 − 27 × 9 + 12 = ?

if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged

After interchanging the signs, the equation we get:

→ 14 × 7 + __**27 ÷ 9**__ - 12 = ?

→ __**14 × 7**__ + 3 - 12 

→ __**98 + 3**__ - 12 

→ 101 - 12 

**→ 89**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

questions.question:
14 is related to 93 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 6 is related to 37. To which of the following is 11 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic follow here is:

**Logic: (1st number × 7) - 5 = 2nd number. **

14 is related to 93

→ (14 × 7) - 5

→ 98 - 5

→ 93

For, 

6 is related to 37

→ (6 × 7) - 5

→ 42 - 5

→ 37

Similarly, 

11 is related,

→ (11 × 7) - 5

→ 77 - 5

**→ 72**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
